entailment.reason: Explicit enjoyment/hobby, direct question paraphrase, and repeated unchanged-condition procedure substantively entail the respective hypotheses.

contradiction.reason: Explicit dispreference, rejected hypothesis, and canceled reservation contradict the affirmative hypotheses.

neutral.reason: An obsolete quoted instruction does not establish personal preference, memo owner hobby, or action completion; descriptions/question content omit lid material and purchase facts.

truncation.limit: Only short pairs were exercised; no long-context NLI assessment or omitted middle-content recovery was tested.

runtime.limit: Single-browser WASM/q8/one-thread measurements. JS heap is not total RAM or peak resident memory. No mobile-device responsiveness or end-to-end product performance claim.

confidenceLimit: Correct argmax does not mean calibrated certainty. The smallest top-versus-second raw-logit margin is reported descriptively, without adding or tuning any acceptance cutoff.

featureScope.usefulNextHypothesis: Investigate NLI as a separate proposed-evidence entailment check after candidate generation, with genuinely new held-out evidence and fixed hypotheses.
unverified: How hypotheses are chosen or generated across arbitrary topics
Source/SHA/offset and author-belief attribution in an integrated pipeline
Production privacy, memory, latency, and device usability of an integrated NLI feature

noRetuning: Fixture, labels, argmax rule, frozen evaluator and the prior 48-document artifacts were not altered after this result.
